To find $\textrm{dim}(\textrm{Null}(A))$, we reduce $A$ to row echelon form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ -6 & 0 & -7 & 4 \\ 0 & 9 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 9 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 9 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+3{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 & 3 & -2 \\ 0 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The reduced matrix has $3$ pivot columns and $1$ non-pivot column (namely, the $3$rd column). 

Therefore,

$$
\textrm{nullity}(A) = \textrm{dim}(\textrm{Null}(A)) = 1.
$$
